==Ingredients==

* ½-[[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]] (15 [[Cookbook:G|g]]) package dried crimini or portobello [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 [[Cookbook:G|g]]) all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1¼ [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (570 [[Cookbook:G|g]]) boneless, skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken thighs]], halved
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 large yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 3 large [[Cookbook:Garlic|cloves garlic]], minced
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* ¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] fresh [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] (1.1 [[Cookbook:L|L]]) low-sodium [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 cup (240 [[Cookbook:ML|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* ¾ cup frozen [[Cookbook:Peas|peas]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], cut into small rounds
* 1 cup small [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]], like elbows or shells
* 2 [[Cookbook:Celery|celery stalks]], chopped
* ½ cup chopped fresh [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon, juiced]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==

# Place the mushrooms in a medium bowl and fill with hot water to cover. Set aside to reconstitute.
# Place the flour in a shallow bowl. Dredge each piece of chicken through the flour to lightly coat on all sides. Set aside.
# In a large [[Cookbook:Stock Pot|stock pot]] over medium-high heat, combine the butter and olive oil.
# When the fat begins to sizzle, add the chicken and cook, turning as needed, until lightly browned on all sides, about 5 to 7 minutes. Remove the meat from the pot and set aside.
# Reduce heat to medium, and add the onion, garlic, thyme, basil, and rosemary. [[Cookbook:Sauté|Sauté]] until onions begin to brown, about 5 minutes.
# Increase heat to high and add broth and water. Bring the broth to a [[Cookbook:Simmer|simmer]].
# Meanwhile, cut the meat into bite-size pieces.
# Drain the mushrooms and squeeze any liquid from them.
# When the broth is simmering, lower heat to medium-high and add the meat, mushrooms, peas, and carrots.
# Return to a simmer, and cook until the carrots are tender, about 5 minutes.
# Add the pasta and celery and cook until just tender, about another 5 minutes.
# Stir in the parsley and lemon juice, then season to taste with salt and pepper.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* This version is '''not''' gluten-free.

* [[Cookbook:Turkey Soup|Turkey Soup]] for a recipe involving egg noodles.
